description: This file defines a set data structure for strings, including methods for set operations such as insert, delete, union, intersection, difference, and checks for containment. It is part of the Kubernetes openapi utility package.

classes.name: String
classes.description: A set of strings implemented via map[string]Empty for minimal memory consumption.

methods.name: NewString
methods.description: Creates a String set from a list of string items.

methods.name: StringKeySet
methods.description: Creates a String set from the keys of a map[string] of any type.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Adds items to the String set.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes items from the String set.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an item is contained in the set.

methods.name: HasAll
methods.description: Checks if all specified items are in the set.

methods.name: HasAny
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified items are in the set.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns a new set with items in the first set not in the second.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Returns a new set with items in either of the two sets.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Returns a new set with items common to both sets.

methods.name: IsSuperset
methods.description: Checks if the set is a superset of another set.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if two sets are equal.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns the set contents as a sorted slice of strings.

methods.name: UnsortedList
methods.description: Returns the set contents as an unsorted slice of strings.

methods.name: PopAny
methods.description: Removes and returns an arbitrary element from the set.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.
